fields.counselling skills: Therapeutic communication, counselling techniques and the practitioner-client relationship.
fields.assessment: Psychological measurement, tests, screening, scoring and interpretation of individual functioning.
fields.diagnosis: Classification and identification of mental or developmental disorders and diagnostic concepts.
fields.ethics: Professional duties, consent, confidentiality, boundaries and responsible psychological practice.
fields.development: Psychological and behavioural change across the lifespan, including attachment and developmental processes.
fields.cognition: Perception, attention, memory, language, reasoning, judgement and other mental information processes.
fields.social: How social interactions, relationships, groups and culture shape thought, feeling and behaviour.
fields.biological: Neural, hormonal or genetic mechanisms explicitly connected to psychological or behavioural functioning.
fields.research methods: Study design, sampling, statistics, evidence evaluation and methodological concepts used in psychological research.
fields.history: Historical schools, theories and concepts whose historical identity is central to their meaning.
fields.mental health: Psychological wellbeing, distress, symptoms, prevention and care that are not chiefly diagnostic classification.
fields.learning: Conditioning, reinforcement, skill acquisition, education and changes in behaviour or knowledge through experience.
fields.personality: Enduring individual differences, traits, temperament, character and theories of personality.
fields.emotion and motivation: Affective states, emotion regulation, drives, goals, needs and processes energising behaviour.
